title: Craftworks
description: Datapack for more accessible Food, Armour and other miscellaneous items via various QOL recipe tweaks.
body:
# Choco's Craftworks!

Want to craft Chainmail/Leather Armour, cook simple meals without Crafting Table or make some use out of Rabbit Hide? Worry not! This recipepack makes early-game armour more accessible, as well as introduces several other minor QOL recipes for greater variety in gameplay options!

### Other Resources
Visit [Chocos/mygazthehealer](https://www.planetminecraft.com/member/mygazthehealer/) in PlanetMinecraft for reporting issues or discussions/recommendation/suggestions for the pack. Refer the gallery for a complete list of recipes changed/added. (Chain, Chainmail, Spyglass textures from Coppernic resourcepack and Bundle textures from Chromatics resourcepack.)

### NOTE
If you disagree with a certain recipe but still want to use this datapack, you may delete the .json file corresponding to that recipe. Feel free to edit this recipepack for your personal preference!
